about: DEVELOPMENT EVIDENCE, NOT CERTIFICATION. Integrators record here the device legs they re-ran at integration (record_dev_evidence.py). Column (d-dev) of the bit-parity board counts a record only while its subject -- the module's bytes, its emitted device text and the array path -- is the live one. Columns (d) and (e) never read this file.
